// Runtime assertions for an allOf member from a mapped package under
// unevaluatedProperties: false. Dropped into the tmp module's orderv1
// package next to the generated file.

package orderv1

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

const validOrder = `{"traceID":"t-1","tenantID":"acme","orderID":"o-1","quantity":2}`

func TestOrderPlaced_DecodesValidMessage(t *testing.T) {
	var msg OrderPlaced
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(validOrder), &msg); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode valid message: %v", err)
	}
	if msg.TraceID != "t-1" || msg.TenantID != "acme" || msg.OrderID != "o-1" || msg.Quantity != 2 {
		t.Errorf("decoded %+v", msg)
	}
}

func TestOrderPlaced_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	for name, c := range map[string]struct {
		body, wantErr string
	}{
		// unevaluatedProperties: false, over the header's and the order's
		// properties together.
		"a key no allOf member declares": {
			body:    `{"traceID":"t-1","tenantID":"acme","orderID":"o-1","quantity":2,"extra":1}`,
			wantErr: "additional properties not allowed",
		},
		// The header's own keywords still apply.
		"a missing header field": {
			body:    `{"tenantID":"acme","orderID":"o-1","quantity":2}`,
			wantErr: "traceID",
		},
		// And so do the order's.
		"a quantity below its minimum": {
			body:    `{"traceID":"t-1","tenantID":"acme","orderID":"o-1","quantity":0}`,
			wantErr: "must be >=",
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var msg OrderPlaced
			err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.body), &msg)
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("decoded %s without an error", c.body)
			}
			if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), c.wantErr) {
				t.Errorf("error %q does not mention %q", err, c.wantErr)
			}
		})
	}
}
